levels.title: One More Friend
levels.intro: Welcome to Plus Planet, Explorer! Adding means putting together. Watch — when one more friend hops in, the group gets bigger!

rounds.spoken: One bunny was hopping, and one more came! Tap each bunny and count!
rounds.success: Two bunnies! One and one more makes two!

rounds.prompt: One more chick joined! Count them all!
rounds.spoken: Two chicks were playing, and one more joined! Count them all!
rounds.success: Three chicks! Two and one more makes three!

rounds.prompt: One more frog hopped in! Count every one!
rounds.spoken: Three frogs were splashing, and one more hopped in! Count every one!
rounds.success: Four frogs! Three and one more makes four!

levels.title: One More, Please!
levels.intro: Zibb loves one more of everything! When I say a number, tap the number that is one more!

rounds.question: What is one more than one?
rounds.spoken: One cookie, then one more! What is one more than one?
rounds.success: Two! One more than one is two!
rounds.hint: Count up! One... then one more!

rounds.question: What is one more than two?
rounds.spoken: What is one more than two?
rounds.success: Three! Two, then three!
rounds.hint: Say two, then count one more!

rounds.question: What is one more than three?
rounds.spoken: What is one more than three?
rounds.success: Four! Three, then four!
rounds.hint: Three, then the very next number!

rounds.question: What is one more than four?
rounds.spoken: Last one! What is one more than four?
rounds.success: Five! You're a one-more wizard!

levels.title: Put-Together Pals
levels.intro: These adding sums are looking for their groups! Count the fruit in each group, then drag the right sum onto it.

matchPairs.prompt: Drag each sum to the group it makes!
matchPairs.spoken: Count each group, then drag the sum that makes it!

pairs.success: One plus one makes two apples!
Two plus one makes three strawberries!
Two plus two makes four oranges!
Four plus one makes five bananas!
Three plus three makes six grapes!
Five plus two makes seven watermelons! Yum!

levels.title: Count-On Train
levels.intro: Here's a big adding trick: you don't have to start at one! Hop on the train and count UP from where we start!

rounds.prompt: Start at two and count up!
rounds.spoken: The train starts at two! Tap two, then keep counting up!
rounds.success: Two, three, four! You counted on!

rounds.prompt: Now start at three and count up!
rounds.spoken: This train starts at three! Count on from three!
rounds.success: Three, four, five, six! Choo choo!

rounds.prompt: The big train starts at five! Count up!
rounds.spoken: Wow, this train starts at five! Count on, Explorer!
rounds.success: Five, six, seven, eight! Counting on is an adding superpower!

levels.title: Snack Sums
levels.intro: Snack time on Plus Planet! Listen to my snack story, add the snacks together, and tap how many there are in all!

rounds.question: 1 cookie plus 1 cookie makes...?
rounds.spoken: I had one cookie, and I baked one more! One plus one makes...?
rounds.success: Two cookies! One plus one makes two!
rounds.hint: Hold up one finger, then one more, and count them!

rounds.question: 2 cupcakes plus 1 cupcake makes...?
rounds.spoken: Two cupcakes, and one more! Two plus one makes...?
rounds.success: Three cupcakes! Two plus one makes three!
rounds.hint: Say two, then count one more!

rounds.question: 2 juices plus 2 juices makes...?
rounds.spoken: Two juices, and two more! Two plus two makes...?
rounds.success: Four juices! Two plus two makes four!
rounds.hint: Count two fingers, then two more!

rounds.question: 3 pretzels plus 2 pretzels makes...?
rounds.spoken: Three pretzels, and two more! Three plus two makes...?
rounds.success: Five pretzels! Three plus two makes five! What a feast!
rounds.hint: Start at three, then count on two more! Four... five!

levels.title: Sum Sorting Station
levels.intro: The sorting machine is mixed up! Work out each sum, then drag it to the number it makes!

sortBins.prompt: Work out each sum, then drag it to its answer!
sortBins.spoken: Add each sum up, then drag it to the number it makes!

levels.title: Big Splash Sums
levels.intro: Time for BIGGER sums! Some friends were playing, then more arrived. Tap every single one to count them all together!

rounds.prompt: 3 fish plus 2 more! Tap them all!
rounds.spoken: Three fish were swimming, then two more splashed in! Tap them all!
rounds.success: Five fish! Three plus two makes five!

rounds.prompt: 4 butterflies plus 2 more! Count them all!
rounds.spoken: Four butterflies were fluttering, then two more landed! Count them all!
rounds.success: Six butterflies! Four plus two makes six!

rounds.prompt: 5 stars plus 3 more! Tap every star!
rounds.spoken: Five stars were twinkling, then three more popped out! Tap every star!
rounds.success: Eight stars! Five plus three makes eight! Dazzling!

levels.title: Double Trouble
levels.intro: Doubles are twin sums — the same number twice! Count each group, then drag its double onto it!

matchPairs.prompt: Drag each double to the group it makes!
matchPairs.spoken: Count each group, then drag the double that makes it!

pairs.success: One plus one makes two socks — a pair!
Two plus two makes four paws!
Three plus three makes six ladybugs!
Four plus four makes eight balloons!
Five plus five makes TEN flowers! The biggest double!
Two plus one makes three cars — that one was a sneaky non-double!

levels.title: Zibb's Adding Party
levels.intro: It's the great adding party! Show me everything you've learned, Explorer — every right answer sets off fireworks!

rounds.question: What is one more than five?
rounds.spoken: Party question one! What is one more than five?
rounds.success: Six! One more than five is six!
rounds.hint: Say five, then count one more!

rounds.question: 2 plus 2 makes...?
rounds.spoken: Two plus two makes...?
rounds.success: Four! That's a double!
rounds.hint: Count two fingers, then two more!

rounds.question: Tap the group that shows 3 plus 1!
rounds.spoken: Three balloons plus one more balloon! Tap the group that shows three plus one!
rounds.success: Four balloons! Three plus one makes four!
rounds.hint: Start at three, count one more, then find that group!

rounds.question: 3 plus 3 makes...?
rounds.spoken: Double trouble! Three plus three makes...?
rounds.success: Six! You remembered your doubles!
rounds.hint: Three fingers on each hand — count them all!

rounds.question: The BIG one! 5 plus 5 makes...?
rounds.spoken: The biggest party question! Five plus five makes...?
rounds.success: TEN! Five plus five makes ten! You're an adding superstar, Explorer! Fireworks for you!
rounds.hint: Count all ten fingers — five on each hand!
